quests.instruction: Find who is bringing the snacks.
quests.hint: Each person is linked to a different item. Follow the food, not the first name you hear.
quests.explanation: Priya is correct. Dan is bringing the drinks, and Priya is bringing the snacks.
quests.textToSpeak: Dan said he'd bring the drinks, and Priya offered to bring the snacks.

quests.instruction: Catch what you do not need to bring.
quests.hint: Some items are needed and one is not. Listen for the negative.
quests.explanation: Lunch is correct. ‘You don't need to bring’ marks the item that is not required.
quests.textToSpeak: For the hike, wear boots and bring a raincoat, but you don't need to bring lunch.

quests.instruction: Tap when the bookstore opens on Sundays.
quests.hint: The schedule has one time for weekdays and another for Sunday. Listen for ‘but’.
quests.explanation: 12:00 is correct. Ten is the weekday time. Sunday opening is at noon.
quests.textToSpeak: The bookstore opens at ten on weekdays, but on Sundays it opens at noon.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap how many people stayed for the discussion.
quests.hint: One number is the whole group, and the other is part of it. The word ‘only’ helps.
quests.explanation: Forty is the number of people who came, but twelve stayed. So the answer is 12.
quests.textToSpeak: There were forty people in the room, but only twelve stayed for the discussion.

quests.instruction: Where does the aunt's daughter study?
quests.hint: Two people and two cities. Match the city to the person who studies.
quests.explanation: Vancouver is correct. The aunt lives in Toronto, but her daughter studies in Vancouver.
quests.textToSpeak: My aunt lives in Toronto, and her daughter studies in Vancouver.

quests.instruction: Focus on the problem that should make you call the front desk.
quests.hint: The word ‘if’ introduces the condition. Focus on what comes after it.
quests.explanation: The heater stops working is correct. It is the condition after ‘if’.
quests.textToSpeak: Please call the front desk if the heater stops working.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap how the pharmacist says to take the medicine.
quests.hint: One way is rejected. Listen for the way that is recommended.
quests.explanation: The answer is with food. ‘Not on an empty stomach’ is what the pharmacist advises against.
quests.textToSpeak: The pharmacist explained that I should take the medicine with food, not on an empty stomach.

quests.instruction: Where is the conference this year?
quests.hint: Two years, two cities. The time expression tells you which one you need.
quests.explanation: Madrid was last year's location. So the answer is Berlin.
quests.textToSpeak: The conference is in Berlin this year, but last year it was in Madrid.

quests.instruction: Identify when Kevin's sister was born.
quests.hint: Each birthday belongs to a different person. Listen for the word ‘sister’.
quests.explanation: October is correct. June is Kevin's month.
quests.textToSpeak: Kevin was born in June, but his sister was born in October.

quests.instruction: Tap when the Leeds train arrives.
quests.hint: Two trains, two times. The minute part is what separates them.
quests.explanation: The answer is 6:20. Ten past six is the Manchester train. Twenty past six is Leeds.
quests.textToSpeak: The train from Manchester arrives at ten past six, and the one from Leeds arrives at twenty past six.

quests.instruction: Identify the color of the speaker's own car.
quests.hint: Ownership words like ‘mine’ show whose car is being described.
quests.explanation: Black is correct. The neighbor has the white car. The speaker says the black one is ‘mine’.
quests.textToSpeak: The white car belongs to my neighbor, and the black one is mine.

quests.instruction: Listen for where the customer would like to sit.
quests.hint: The number of seats and the location are different details.
quests.explanation: By the window is correct. Four is how many people there are.
quests.textToSpeak: I'd like a table for four, please, by the window if possible.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap the sister's job.
quests.hint: Two siblings and two jobs. Connect each job to the right person.
quests.explanation: Journalist is correct. The brother is the pilot.
quests.textToSpeak: Julia's brother is a pilot, and her sister is a journalist.

quests.instruction: Which bus number can you take?
quests.hint: Numbers like these share a sound. Listen to the second part of the number.
quests.explanation: 22 is correct. Twenty-two is two tens and two ones. Ten minutes is the walking time.
quests.textToSpeak: It's about a ten-minute walk from the station, or you can take bus twenty-two.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap why he can't come.
quests.hint: The reason comes after ‘because’. The day is only background.
quests.explanation: The answer is a dentist appointment. It explains why he is not available.
quests.textToSpeak: He can't come on Wednesday because he has a dentist appointment.

quests.instruction: Notice how many eggs the speaker needs to buy.
quests.hint: Do a quick calculation: how many are needed, and how many are missing?
quests.explanation: The answer is 1. Three are needed and two are at home, so one more is needed.
quests.textToSpeak: The recipe needs three eggs, but I only have two, so I'll go to the store for one more.

quests.instruction: Find what Omar is wearing.
quests.hint: Two men are described in different ways. Focus on the description of Omar.
quests.explanation: Ravi is the tall man by the fountain. So the answer is gray jacket.
quests.textToSpeak: Ravi is the tall man standing next to the fountain, and Omar is the one in the gray jacket.

quests.instruction: Tap the day the gallery is free.
quests.hint: One day is different from all the others. Listen for the word that signals it.
quests.explanation: Thursday is correct. On every other day there is a ten-dollar fee.
quests.textToSpeak: The gallery is free on Thursdays, but on other days it costs ten dollars.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap what you should wear.
quests.hint: The reason for the advice can help you predict what is recommended.
quests.explanation: The answer is comfortable shoes. Two hours of walking is the reason.
quests.textToSpeak: Please wear comfortable shoes because we'll be walking around the campus for two hours.

quests.instruction: Listen for who takes the children to practice.
quests.hint: Two people do two different steps. Focus on the second step.
quests.explanation: The answer is Luis. Marta picks up the children first, and Luis takes them to practice.
quests.textToSpeak: Marta will pick up the children, and then Luis will take them to soccer practice.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap how soon a taxi could be there.
quests.hint: There are two waiting times. Match each one to its type of transport.
quests.explanation: 4 minutes is correct. Twelve minutes is the bus. The taxi is faster.
quests.textToSpeak: The next bus is in twelve minutes, but a taxi could be here in four.

quests.instruction: Tap what the speaker liked best about the trip.
quests.hint: The word ‘best’ points to the favorite part. Ignore the other places and things.
quests.explanation: The answer is the food. The hotel and beach are mentioned, but the food is called the best.
quests.textToSpeak: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach, but the food was the best part of the trip.

quests.instruction: Tap who you should email.
quests.hint: The person who is away is not the person you should contact.
quests.explanation: Correct: her assistant. The manager is on vacation, so the instruction is to email the assistant.
quests.textToSpeak: I'm afraid the manager is on vacation until the fifteenth, so please email her assistant.

quests.instruction: Focus on how long the homework was.
quests.hint: ‘Half’ describes the students, not the homework. Listen for the number of questions.
quests.explanation: 20 questions is correct. Half is the part of the class that finished.
quests.textToSpeak: Only half of the class finished the homework, which was twenty questions.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap when the neighbors are noisy.
quests.hint: Two times of day, two opposite descriptions. Listen for ‘noisy’.
quests.explanation: The answer is at night. During the day, the neighbors are helpful.
quests.textToSpeak: Our neighbors are noisy at night, but they're very helpful during the day.

quests.instruction: Notice how much the speaker actually paid.
quests.hint: There is an original price and a final price. Ask which one the speaker paid.
quests.explanation: $20 is correct. Thirty was the shirt's price. The coupon brought it down to twenty.
quests.textToSpeak: The shirt was thirty dollars, but I got it for twenty with a coupon.

quests.instruction: Pick out what the students must write.
quests.hint: Two tasks are given, one for reading and one for writing.
quests.explanation: Reading pages ten to fifteen is the other task. So the answer is a short summary.
quests.textToSpeak: The teacher asked us to read pages ten to fifteen and write a short summary.

quests.instruction: Tap how long the speaker had to wait.
quests.hint: The waiting time is connected to the next train, not to the late bus.
quests.explanation: An hour is correct. The speaker missed the train and waited for the next one.
quests.textToSpeak: The bus was late, so I missed my train and had to wait an hour for the next one.

quests.instruction: Clear the glass and tap who you should ask for.
quests.hint: Listen for the title and the family name, not just the name.
quests.explanation: The answer is Mr. Silva. The title ‘Mr.’ shows the person is a man.
quests.textToSpeak: Ask for Mr. Silva at the reception on the ground floor, then take the elevator to the fourth floor.

quests.instruction: Notice where the meeting will actually be.
quests.hint: A usual place is rejected, and a new one is announced with ‘so’.
quests.explanation: The projector is broken, so the meeting moves. So the answer is the library.
quests.textToSpeak: The meeting isn't in the conference room today because the projector is broken, so we'll use the library.
